items.title: NS-1: closed RefusalKind enum + typed refusal field on Packet
items.objective: Define a closed enum RefusalKind (LivenessStale{age_seconds, threshold_seconds}, BasisInvalidated, PreflightHeld as the initial closed set) in crates/nightshiftd/src/packet.rs; add an optional typed `refusal` field to Packet; populate it in the liveness-gate failure path (pipeline.rs liveness_gate_failed); the existing free-text blocked[] strings stay as DISPLAY, never removed. Deterministic refusal taxonomy so downstream consumers (maude routing) never parse free text. First real packet of the nightshift-functional-mvp dogfood - deliberately small to shake the pipeline.
stop_conditions: the enum would require changing liveness-gate semantics (gate behavior is out of scope; only the RECORDING of the refusal changes)
the free-text blocked[] display strings would need to be removed
any edit outside crates/nightshiftd/* would be needed to finish
